course.name: Thinking in Flows
course.description: Wire typed values, use variables, and repair a deterministic text workflow.
course.longDescription: Prerequisite: Welcome to Flow-Like or a working Simple Event → Print Info board. Use Desktop and the standard catalog. In 45 minutes, build a text normalizer, organize it with a layer, and verify a deliberate repair. No model, network call, or provider account is required. Practice checks are manual.

challenges.prompt: Trim String has a valid value wired into Print Info, but Print Info has no execution input connection. What happens?
challenges.explanation: Print Info executes when its execution input is reached; a data connection supplies its Message.

options.label: Print Info does not run
The data wire starts Print Info
Trim String sends a toast itself

lessons.title: Change a value during a run

challenges.prompt: Label defaults to draft. Set Label contains ready but is outside the executed path. What does Get Label return in a new run?
challenges.explanation: Only an executed Set changes the current run’s variable state.

options.label: ready
The previous run’s final value
draft

challenges.prompt: Where should To Upper Case be connected?
challenges.explanation: Uppercase conversion transforms a value; Print Info consumes that value when it executes.

options.label: To the App’s storage settings
Between Trim String’s data output and Print Info’s Message
Between the two execution diamonds

lessons.title: Put a boundary around a transformation

challenges.prompt: A layer named Manager Approval contains no approval logic. Can a release rely on it to wait for a manager?
challenges.explanation: Names and comments describe intent. Only implemented and tested logic provides approval behavior.

options.label: No; implement and test the approval behavior
Yes; the layer name enables it
Yes; collapse automatically adds a pause

challenges.prompt: After fixing the bypass, why run cedar with the same spaces again?
challenges.explanation: Holding the input constant makes this deterministic repair comparable. The remaining cases still need testing.

options.label: It guarantees all possible inputs will pass
It removes the earlier failed run
It isolates the effect of the repaired connection

challenges.prompt: After adding a Prefix input to a layer, the outer caller still supplies only Label. What must you check?
challenges.explanation: A changed interface needs compatible values and connections inside and outside the layer.

options.label: The location of the layer on the canvas
A source or default for Prefix and both sides of the layer boundary
Only the layer’s display name

challenges.prompt: The new run logs crate b although the requirement is CRATE B. Which evidence targets the issue?
challenges.explanation: Execution already reached the logger. The wrong value points to the data path or transformation input.

options.label: Trace Message backward and check whether it consumes Uppercase String
